app.name: Wiredex
app.tagline: A home for every part and every project on your workbench.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: Nothing on the bench yet. Describe your parts, then start a project for what you build next.

search.title: Parts
search.intro: Every part you've described. Search by name or number, narrow by category, and filter by what a category's parts hold.
search.onlyThisCategory: Only this category, not its subcategories
search.empty: No parts yet. Start with a category, then describe the parts that belong to it.

form.name: Name
form.pickFirst: Pick a category to see the fields its parts have.
form.noFields: This category declares no fields yet.

error.badNumber: Not a number. Write it like 4k7, 4700 or 4.7e3.

part.noFields: This category declares no fields yet.

inUse.intro: It can't be deleted while a bill of materials names it. Take it off these first:

editor.title: Edit the pinout
editor.empty: No pins yet. Add one, or paste a table.
editor.functionsHint: Alternate functions are separated by spaces.
editor.discardQuestion: Discard the changes to this pinout?
editor.leaveQuestion: Leave the pinout editor? Your unsaved changes will be lost.

paste.title: Paste a pin table
paste.label: Pasted table
paste.hint: One pin per line: number, label, type, alternate functions, voltage. Separate them with tabs, semicolons or commas.
paste.unknownType: Type kept as pasted: it is none of the eight.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The tree your parts are filed under. Each category adds fields to the ones it inherits.
categories.addAtRoot: It will sit at the top level.
categories.pickOne: Pick a category to work on its fields.

tracking.label: Tracked individually
tracking.resolvedYes: Inherited: yes, parts here are tracked individually.
tracking.resolvedNo: Inherited: no, parts here are counted in lots.

stocking.label: Not stocked
stocking.resolvedYes: Inherited: yes, parts here are consumables, never received or counted short.
stocking.resolvedNo: Inherited: no, parts here are stocked.

schema.title: Fields of {{name}}
schema.heading: Fields
schema.none: No fields yet. Add the first one.
schema.label: Label

review.title: This part needs a look
review.intro: Some stored values no longer fit the category's fields. Nothing was lost — fix them and save.

problem.wrong_kind: {{key}} holds a value of the wrong kind.
problem.unknown_key: {{key}} is no longer a field of this category.

picker.placeholder: Type a name or a part number

refused.tooLarge: That file is too large. The most a file may be is 25 MB.
refused.unsupported: That file isn't a PDF, a picture or a ZIP archive.
refused.notAPhoto: A project's photos are PNG, JPEG or WebP pictures.
refused.quota: There isn't enough space left in your workspace for that file.
refused.duplicate: That file is already attached here.

photos.title: Photos
photos.chosen: {{name}} · will be added as a photo

version.updateAvailable: A newer version is running. Reload to update.

locations.title: Locations
locations.intro: The tree your stock sits in. Each location carries a short code you can read off a bin.
locations.addAtRoot: It will sit at the top level.
locations.pickOne: Pick a location to rename, move or delete it.
locations.filterPlaceholder: A name or a code, like WX-L-0001

picker.placeholder: Type a name, a path or a code

stock.title: Stock
stock.notStocked: Not stocked: this part's category is for consumables, so none of it is received, and a bill of materials never counts it short.
stock.notStockedHeld: What it held before can still be recounted and moved.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.belowReserved: {{count}} are reserved for a build here; recount to at least that, or cancel the reservation first.

move.title: Move stock
move.aboveAvailable: Only {{count}} are available to move here; the rest is reserved for a build.

holdings.title: Held for builds
holdings.none: No build holds any of this.

receive.title: Receive units
receive.intro: Each board becomes its own tracked unit with a code.

delete.question: Delete {{code}}?
delete.hint: A retired unit can be deleted for good; its stock history stays.

search.title: Units
search.intro: Find a board by its code, serial or MAC.
search.label: Search units
search.prompt: Type a code, serial or MAC to search.

quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.stockHint: Optional: where it goes and how many. Leave both blank to add the part alone.
quickAdd.notStocked: This category isn't stocked: its parts, such as solder or wire, are added without stock and never counted.
quickAdd.unitsHint: This category tracks each one on its own, so every unit gets its own WX-U code. Serials and MACs can be added later, on each unit's page.

error.quantity: A whole number from 1 to {{max, number}}.

quickAdd.taken: {{name}} already has this manufacturer and part number.

import.title: Import from a sheet
import.intro: Bring parts and stock in from a spreadsheet saved as CSV. Nothing is written until a preview of the sheet is clean and you import it, and then the whole sheet lands at once.
import.columns: Columns: category, name, manufacturer, mpn, package, location (a path or a WX-L code), quantity, serial and mac, plus any attribute key, such as resistance. Headers can be in English or Portuguese, and cells separated by commas, semicolons or tabs.
import.fileHint: The file fills the text box below, so a cell can be fixed right there.
import.textHint: Paste from a spreadsheet, or fix what the file filled in. The first row names the columns.
import.empty: Choose a file or paste a sheet first.
import.tooLong: A sheet holds at most {{max, number}} characters. Split it into two.
import.clean: The preview is clean. Nothing is written until you import it.
import.problems: The preview found problems. Fix them in the sheet and preview it again.

blocked.stale: The sheet changed since its preview. Preview it again to import it.
blocked.problems: Fix every problem and preview the sheet again to import it.
blocked.nothing: The sheet has no rows to import.

import.changed: What this sheet would do changed since its preview, so nothing was imported. Preview it again to see what it does now.
import.refused: The sheet has problems now, so nothing was imported. Preview it again to see them in their rows.

refusal.not_utf8: The file isn't UTF-8 text. Save it as CSV UTF-8 and choose it again.
refusal.empty: The sheet has no header row naming its columns.
refusal.unknown_column: “{{column}}” is neither a column like name or quantity nor an attribute key like resistance.
refusal.too_many_columns: A sheet holds at most 64 columns.
refusal.too_many_rows: A sheet holds at most 500 rows. Split it into two.

table.heading: Preview
table.caption: What each row of the sheet will do

problem.unknown_category: That category isn't in the catalog.
problem.not_an_attribute: {{column}} isn't a field of this category.
problem.unknown_location: That location isn't in the tree.
problem.location_needed: Stock needs a location to go into.
problem.quantity_needed: A location needs a quantity to put there.
problem.bad_quantity: A quantity is a whole number from 1: up to 1,000,000 of a lot, or 100 units.
problem.too_many_units: At most 100 units are received at once.
problem.counted_in_lots: This part is counted in lots, so it takes a quantity, not a serial or a MAC.
problem.one_unit_per_label: A serial or a MAC labels one unit, so its quantity is blank or 1.
problem.bad_serial: Not a serial that can be stored: {{detail}}
problem.bad_mac: A MAC is six hex octets, like aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff.
problem.extra_cells: This row has a cell past the last column. A cell holding the separator needs quotes.
problem.sheet_too_many_units: A sheet receives at most 500 units. Split it into two.
problem.not_stocked: This part's category isn't stocked, so it takes no stock. Leave its stock blank.

list.title: Projects
list.intro: Everything you build, the one you worked on last first. Search by name or narrow by tag.
list.empty: No projects yet. Start one for the next thing you build.

tags.hint: Enter or a comma adds a tag; Backspace removes the last one.

error.tooLong: A tag has at most {{max}} characters.
error.control: A tag can't hold a control character.
error.tooMany: A project carries at most {{max}} tags.

page.noSuchRevision: This project has no such revision.

revision.name: {{label}} – {{summary}}
revision.heading: Revision {{name}}
revision.deleteOnly: A project keeps at least one revision; delete the project instead.
revision.deleteHolds: This revision holds stock; cancel the reservation or dismantle the build before deleting it.

holdings.error: What this build holds couldn't be loaded.

revisionDialog.label: Label
revisionDialog.labelHint: Letters, digits, ".", "-" or "_", up to 16: A, v2, 1.1.

error.label: Use 1 to 16 letters, digits, ".", "-" or "_", starting and ending with a letter or a digit.

bom.title: Bill of materials
bom.error: The bill of materials couldn't be loaded.
bom.locked: Only a draft's bill of materials can change; this revision is {{status}}.
bom.caption: Lines of the bill of materials

report.title: Shortages
report.rebuildTitle: What building it again would be missing

editor.partNeeded: Pick a part from the catalog.

refusal.invalid_designator: {{item}} isn't a designator like R1 or C12: 1 to 8 letters, then a number from 1 to 9,999.
refusal.invalid_range: The range {{item}} has to run upwards within one prefix, as R1–R4 does.
refusal.too_many_designators: A line holds at most 256 designators.
refusal.quantity_mismatch: With designators, the quantity is how many there are.
refusal.invalid_quantity: Give a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
refusal.unknown_part: That part isn't in the catalog any more; pick another.
refusal.too_many_lines: A bill of materials holds at most 500 lines.
refusal.revision_locked: Only a draft's bill of materials can change.

lifecycle.dismantledNote: This build is dismantled; fork it to build it again.

reserve.title: Reserve parts
reserve.loadError: The bill of materials couldn't be loaded.
reserve.nothingStocked: Nothing on this BOM is stocked; reserving takes nothing off the shelves.
reserve.automatic: Leave a part's boards unchecked to let the system choose.
reserve.wiringNote: The wiring checks found these. They don't stop the reserve.

dismantle.title: Dismantle the build
dismantle.explain: Everything the build used returns to the location you choose.

refusal.transition_not_allowed: This revision is {{status}}, so it can't {{transition}}.
refusal.empty_bom: Add a part to the bill of materials before reserving.
refusal.unit_not_needed: Board {{unit}} is of a part this build doesn't need.
refusal.too_many_units: More boards are chosen than the part needs.
refusal.unknown_location: That location isn't in this workspace.
refusal.stock_changed: The stock changed while reserving. Try again.

netlist.title: Wiring
netlist.locked: Only a draft's wiring can change; this revision is {{status}}.
netlist.caption: Nets of the revision

resolution.unchecked: not checked: the part has no pinout

refusal.invalid_net_name: A net name needs 1 to 32 printable characters.
refusal.net_name_taken: The net {{net}} already has that name.
refusal.invalid_pin_ref: {{item}} isn't a pin like U1.25 or U2.SDA; a part with no pinout takes pin numbers, like R1.1.
refusal.unknown_designator: {{item}}: that designator isn't on this revision's BOM.
refusal.unknown_part: {{item}}: the part on that designator isn't in the catalog any more.
refusal.unknown_pin: {{item}}: that part has no such pin.
refusal.ambiguous_pin: {{item}} could be pins {{candidates}}; name one by number.
refusal.no_pins: A net needs at least one pin.
refusal.too_many_pins: A net connects at most 256 pins.
refusal.too_many_nets: A revision holds at most 500 nets.
refusal.revision_locked: Only a draft's wiring can change.

findings.title: Wiring checks
findings.none: No problems found in the wiring.

messages.unknown_part: {{ref}}: the part on {{designator}} isn't in the catalog.
messages.no_pinout: {{part}} has no pinout, so the pins of {{designators}} aren't checked.
messages.pin_reused: {{refs}} is in more than one net.

login.title: Log in
login.noSignup: There's no sign-up: the owner creates every account.

error.unavailable: Wiredex can't be reached right now. Try again shortly.

sessions.title: Your devices
sessions.intro: Every browser and app logged in to your account. Log out any you don't recognise.
sessions.revokeError: That device couldn't be logged out. Try again.
